t: You're on Baylis Road in Lambeth, a street running between Westminster Bridge Road to the south-west and Waterloo Road to the north-east. It takes its name from Lilian Baylis, who managed the Old Vic and Sadler's Wells theatres. She also ran an opera company that became the English National Opera, a theatre company that evolved into the English National Theatre, and a ballet company that eventually became The Royal Ballet. So a good deal of London's national performing arts trace back to her work.
